findings.location: §1 line 30 (cumulative upstream tags header) vs §3 lines 89-90 and §7 line 206
findings.message: Cumulative upstream tags header lists `@adr: ADR-01` only, but §3 matrix rows 89-90 cite `@adr: ADR.01.03.1050` and `@adr: ADR.01.03.f5f5`, and §7 line 206 expands to six ADR refs total: `ADR-01 | ADR.01.03.5c3c | ADR.01.03.1050 | ADR.01.03.f5f5 | ADR.01.05.3afa | ADR.01.05.9107`. The cumulative header is the artifact's traceability contract; it must enumerate every upstream element tag cited in the body.
findings.recommendation: Update line 30 cumulative upstream tags to include all element-level ADR refs: `@adr: ADR-01 | @adr: ADR.01.03.5c3c | @adr: ADR.01.03.1050 | @adr: ADR.01.03.f5f5 | @adr: ADR.01.05.3afa | @adr: ADR.01.05.9107`. Verify each tag resolves in the upstream ADR doc.
